scenario: # Acceptance of V/02.4: the recorder writes a file camera into the volume of its own server (the holder V/01, a live obsd). Format — README.

request: @manual stub driver with G.711 audio: recording running, audio_codec PCMU, volume stream <record>/e<epoch>/audio with AAC frames; audio 2 records mic 2
@manual mic absent or disabled: video continues, audio_reason no mic; G.726 becomes AAC; L16, MPA become AAC; another codec: audio_reason codec not supported: <codec>

@manual holder on another server: recording from the receiver writes audio frames of kind audio; no audio frames: video continues, audio_reason no sound frames; loss of the endpoint does not interrupt video or fire the watchdog
@manual have and written_through advance only by video; silent audio stream: have grows and windows do not stall
@manual backup when: offline: the ring keeps audio, publication begins at the first keyframe, stream …/audio has no gap against video
@manual backfill: card export and copying from backup write …/backfill/audio only for the times of taken groups; a source without audio is not a gap

@manual relay: push and pull carry audio frames to the centre; the centre request exports archive audio with mic equal to the request audio; camera-cluster: ring, card and export use only the requested number; audio 0 and the first microphone number deliver each frame once; a malformed audio frame is dropped while request video continues

expect: 200 {"rows": [{"id": "door-x", "phase": "waiting", "reason": "replica source on a backup volume: door-b"}]}

request: @manual run longer than 900 s: source minutes land in …/backfill on volume disk-b, oldest gap first; replica_lag_s decreases, to grows; a V/05 job on replica does not receive an order from the device archive

@manual disk-b ring is smaller than source coverage: over_quota: true; minutes evicted by the ring are not downloaded again (to does not decrease and …/backfill does not grow for them); the source ring overtakes the copy: replica_lost_s grows

@manual replica_from changes: a new revision, to starts anew; source removed: waiting, accumulated data remains visible for its retention period; live recording becomes replica: pipeline removed, delivery stream closed unless other consumers remain (V/01.2 N1.2c)
@manual hold on a camera with one replica: the /spans door reports copied_to; sealing waits until everything below the end of the hold is delivered

@manual source with gaps: above 64 absent spans the oldest is removed, replica_absent_dropped_s grows; holder dies within a range: to has not advanced beyond landed data, the remainder is downloaded; source younger than 900 s: replica_lost_s 0
@manual live driver with a device archive (the stand has a file): replica_from device, camera has no other consumers: holder idle, stream not read, archive reaches the volume through /playback
@manual device and nonempty stream: reason «replica from device: stream is set»; cam ref:<ref>: «replica from device: other cluster»
@manual scan: a landed part without a running holder creates a detjob job; while running there is no order; moving the recording neither downloads the minutes again nor orders them again
@manual lag measurement: recorder with 16 cameras, max_playbacks exhausted: 503 device busy, source under grace; per-camera lag is in replica_lag_s

@manual two cameras on one card: one volume row with both sets of segments; quota is the budget of the whole card; budget eviction removes the oldest delivered data across the card, so a higher-bitrate camera shortens its neighbour; the open segment is retained; undelivered data is evicted last
@manual recording of a camera whose holder is on another server: waiting, reason edge volume serves its own server; the rows door has accepted the row
@manual volume when always: card recording runs without a new row revision; offline: standby with a ring, camera stream open without other consumers (V/01.2 N1.2c)
@manual camera removed: recorder removes the row; card segments remain and are evicted first from the debt; a new row for this camera on this volume sees them

@manual camera moves to another server with an edge volume: new holder immediately orders its card row; former row waiting, debt is copied; after 7200 s without debt the card recorder removes it; the unit does not restart: row revision does not grow for an hour

@manual single-member cluster, cam/cameras/1 with cfw://local, volume without when and no primary recording: card recording writes as always; primary appears: standby; camera row or book unreadable: retain the former decision

@manual another camera in the box: a range request reaches the card recorder in the poll answer; it reads segments and uploads POST /ingest/upload using its role leaf to its own receiver or a stream token to another; the recording role in the book is backup for both always and offline

@manual engine answers SEQUENCE_LOST on a live recording frame: segment.lost event in the log with of cam/<camera> and fields cam, recording, volume, occurred; samples_refused{SEQUENCE_LOST} grows; the stand cannot force the engine to lose the sequence
@manual repeats within 60 s: one row, then a row with repeats; QUEUE_FULL and backfill frames do not raise the event
